name: The internet
kid: The internet is lots of networks holding hands. Tap it to see what’s inside!
nerd: ~75 000 autonomous systems exchanging routes with BGP. Tap to unfold the path through the ISP.

inside.title: Inside the internet
inside.kid: The internet isn’t one big cloud. It’s lots of networks, each run by a different company, holding hands. The coloured patches show whose boxes your parcel passes – and the faint circles far away are a few of the many other networks.
inside.nerd: A network of networks: your ISP’s access network and MPLS core, then settlement-free peering at an internet exchange (or paid transit), ending at a CDN cache close to you. Each shaded area is one operator; tens of thousands of other autonomous systems are out there too.
